measurements.why: Multi-file spread was MECHANICAL: a grammar change propagating through a fixed pipeline, every site mirrorable from the existing _slice implementation. No independent decision sites. File count without contested choices does not create difficulty.
Additive feature with a fully pinned spec. Symptom site == fix site.

conclusion: 8 designs, all ~100%. The common property is that every one was fully determined by its own description. The SWE-bench cell 'files>=3 AND >=60 LOC -> 0.4%' does NOT transfer to authored additive tasks; it described bug fixes where the decisions were genuinely contested.
